item.text:
**The four round-41 defects are corrected, but I would not yet accept both slices as fully proved.** The code now uses stored-order lanes and position marks for undirected shapes, guards both composite entry points, accepts an unrecorded three-choice question, and retitles the disclosure. The saved headless result reports the corrected axes on the fortnight page. [thesis.js](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/ui/src/model/thesis.js:39), [contract.js](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/ui/src/model/contract.js:86), [composite.js](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/ui/src/idea/composite.js:107), [RESULT.md](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/page-contract/RESULT.md:24)

The remaining gap is in the **D397 display proof**. Its agreed design calls for exercising the drawer with a nonempty list **and no assessment**, and checking that markup in a part is escaped. The unit file checks the adapter and snapshot; the saved browser result describes an assessed question and the before-opening state. I found no saved result for those two drawer cases. The rendering code appears to put the section outside the assessment branch and escape both texts, but that is not the promised point-of-use proof. [Display design](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/not-judged-display/DESIGN.md:44), [drawer](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/ui/src/components/thesis-detail.js:154), [UI tests](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/poc/ui/test/not-judged.test.js:1)

The next step toward production is therefore one bounded $0 check through the drawer: open a question with no assessment and a nonempty part containing markup, verify the text appears beside the absence of an assessment and is rendered as text, then record the result. After that, review the actual serving path for a new-system ledger; the Idea planner remains a separate gate-5 item.

The reported suite and mutant outcomes are saved evidence; I did not rerun the write-producing checks in this read-only review.

CONSENSUS: no, because the agreed unassessed-question and escaping checks have not yet been evidenced through the drawer.
